title: Summerland Full Day Lunch Wine Tour (Incl. Tasting Fees & Grat!)
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Summerland Area
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Get ready for a grape escape with our Summerland Wine Tours along Bottleneck Drive! Picture yourself sipping incredible wines while cruising through stunning vineyards, all just a hop away from Penticton. We’ve got your ride covered with pick-up and drop-off, bottled water, and air-conditioned comfort—no sweat! The Holy Sip Lunch Tour takes you to 5 fabulous wineries (all tasting fees included!) where you’ll taste up to 24 delicious wines and enjoy a leisurely lunch with jaw-dropping views (the cost of lunch is payable directly to the restaurant). It’s a day of wine, views, and pure relaxation!
